mechanism_narrative: Workplace mobility has rebounded 26.7 points off its t-2w trough (-47.6 to -20.9), and each further step of commuting normalization adds weekday footfall to retail and recreation venues, so mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days exceeds the -16.9 trailing four-week mean.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days averages below -16.9 (the trailing four-week mean) while WORKPLACES continues to rise, or WORKPLACES falls back below -35.0 within two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT has recovered 7.7 points in two weeks and crossed back above -30.0 (-29.0), the level at which discretionary trip-making resumes; retail-and-recreation visits follow transit trips with a short lag, so RETAIL_REC rises above its trailing mean within two weeks.

failure_condition: TRANSIT holds above -30.0 for two consecutive weeks yet RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days averages below -20.1 (its t-0w level).

failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL falls below 11.1 while WORKPLACES stays above -25.0, yet RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days averages below -16.9.
